responses.message: whats the deal with the viral post saying 20 min naps are "worse than no nap"

It's a misread. The post is riffing on a small study about naps that ran *long* enough to hit deep sleep, which can cause grogginess (sleep inertia) after waking. A 10–20 minute nap usually stays in light sleep and is the length most research supports for alertness.

The replies under it have the better take — several sleep researchers quote-posted it pointing out the original paper said nothing about short naps being harmful.
